title: Bacteroides ovatus-derived N-methylserotonin inhibit colorectal cancer via the HTR1D-mediated cAMP-PKA-NF-kappaB signaling axis.
authors: He, Jikai; Jia, Jiaqi; Qu, Wenhao; Zhang, Shuyu; Fan, Keyu; Lin, Runze; Zhao, Wei; Niu, Yan; Huang, Yanqiang; Jia, Lizhou
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肠道菌群代谢物N-甲基血清素通过HTR1D介导的信号通路抑制结直肠癌，属于肿瘤生物学与微生物组研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模内容，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To analyze differences in gut microbiota composition, metabolites, and metabolic pathways between healthy individuals and colorectal cancer (CRC) patients, and to investigate the inhibitory effects of N-methylserotonin (NMS) produced by Bacteroides ovatus (B.o) from orange fiber on CRC progression and its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: (1) Fecal samples from CRC patients (n=26) and healthy controls (n=20) were collected for metagenomic sequencing and untargeted metabolomics analysis; (2) The ability of B.o to produce NMS from orange fiber was validated in vitro; (3) A CRC mouse model was established using azoxymethane (AOM)/dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) induction, followed by evaluation of body weight, rectal bleeding, colorectal length, tumor number, and intestinal barrier function; (4) Network pharmacology, molecular docking, and western blot analysis were combined to verify the mechanism of action; (5) 16S rRNA sequencing was performed to analyze gut microbiota changes. RESULTS: (1) CRC patients showed significantly increased metabolic pathways including glycolysis, methane metabolism, beneficial amino acid degradation, and linoleic acid degradation, along with significantly decreased B.o abundance and NMS levels, which were positively correlated; (2) NMS significantly inhibited CRC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion, while promoting apoptosis; (3) Combined treatment with B.o and orange fiber or NMS alone reduced tumorigenesis and improved intestinal barrier function; (4) Mechanistic studies revealed that these effects could be mediated through downregulation of 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 1D (HTR1D) expression and inhibition of the cAMP/PKA/IkappaBalpha/NF-kappaB pathway; (5) The treatments optimized gut microbiota structure and metabolite composition. CONCLUSION: B.o and its metabolite NMS possibly inhibit CRC progression by modulating the HTR1D-mediated cAMP/PKA/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, while improving gut microbiota structure, providing a novel therapeutic target for CRC prevention and treatment.
abstract_zh: 目的：分析健康个体与结直肠癌（CRC）患者之间肠道菌群组成、代谢物及代谢通路的差异，并探讨由橙皮纤维中卵形拟杆菌（B.o）产生的N-甲基血清素（NMS）对CRC进展的抑制作用及其潜在机制。方法：（1）收集CRC患者（n=26）和健康对照者（n=20）的粪便样本，进行宏基因组测序和非靶向代谢组学分析；（2）体外验证B.o从橙皮纤维产生NMS的能力；（3）使用氧化偶氮甲烷（AOM）/葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导建立CRC小鼠模型，随后评估体重、直肠出血、结直肠长度、肿瘤数量及肠道屏障功能；（4）结合网络药理学、分子对接和蛋白质印迹分析验证作用机制；（5）进行16S rRNA测序分析肠道菌群变化。结果：（1）CRC患者表现出糖酵解、甲烷代谢、有益氨基酸降解和亚油酸降解等代谢通路显著增加，同时B.o丰度和NMS水平显著降低，且两者呈正相关；（2）NMS显著抑制CRC细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，同时促进凋亡；（3）B.o与橙皮纤维联合治疗或单独使用NMS可减少肿瘤发生并改善肠道屏障功能；（4）机制研究表明，这些效应可能通过下调5-羟色胺受体1D（HTR1D）表达和抑制cAMP/PKA/IkappaBalpha/NF-kappaB通路介导；（5）治疗优化了肠道菌群结构和代谢物组成。结论：B.o及其代谢物NMS可能通过调节HTR1D介导的cAMP/PKA/NF-kappaB信号通路抑制CRC进展，同时改善肠道菌群结构，为CRC预防和治疗提供了新的治疗靶点。
